_purpose: The form-mandated instrument that renders on EVERY review case regardless of what is in the standards library. Captured in eCAF_ReviewSummaries as the Item11Elements and CompetencyDomains JSON blobs. The standards library ADDS depth; it never replaces this.
_VERIFY_AGAINST_FORM: The build package mandates 'the DHA 455 item 11 element set' and '16 competency constructs across the six domains' but does not enumerate either, and neither DHA Form 455 nor the DHA FPPE Template was supplied to this build.
item11Elements below is derived from the four 455-I11:<key> tokens that actually appear in standards-seed.csv (standardofcare, medication, blood, consults).

competencyConstructs below is derived from the FPPE Template Section 4 subsection references cited in standards-seed.csv (Patient Care A/B/C, Professional Knowledge A/C, ICS A/B, PBLI A/B), expanded to 16 across the six named domains.

ACTION FOR THE OPERATOR: open DHA Form 455 and the DHA FPPE Template, reconcile the two arrays below, and correct them before any real review is entered. Editing this file is the only change needed — the review screen renders from it and the aggregation reads element keys from it. Nothing is hard-coded downstream.
Reconciling this file is a listed gate in docs/dry-run.md and must be closed before cutover.

overallDetermination.note: This is the ONLY overall rating the reviewer supplies. It does not and must not propagate to DHA 455 item 12 (Poor/Fair/Good/Superior) — no crosswalk exists between the two scales. See CLAUDE.md hard rule.

_blobShape._why_array_not_map: Stored as a JSON ARRAY of {key,result} records, not an object map. Power Fx ParseJSON returns an Untyped object whose fields can only be reached by literal name (obj.medication), so an object map cannot be read with a variable element key — which is exactly what the aggregation does when it loops over the element set. An array is walkable with ForAll/Filter and keeps the element set data-driven. Do not 'simplify' this to a map.
_blobShape.CompetencyDomains: [{"key":"PC-A","result":"Satisfactory"}, ... one record per construct key above]
